ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, the Web Site and all data submitted, transmitted, stored or generated through the Interface or the Web Site (including borrower and loan data), and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers any such right, title or interest to TrueLink, except for the limited license expressly granted in Section 8(d). TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in and to the results and work product of the Support Services prepared for Client, excluding TrueLink's Intellectual Property existing prior to or developed independently of such Support Services, as to which TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property to the extent embedded in such results and work product for Client's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of either party's Intellectual Property.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but the Agreement never confirms ours, so we have added a matching clause stating that we retain all rights in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and the data we put through the Interface, that TrueLink assigns us the Support Services work product with a licence back for its own pre-existing IP, and that no joint ownership is created. We have preserved the limited Credit Data licence in Section 8(d); if TrueLink prefers, we can accept vendor ownership of its generic tools and know-how provided we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Support Services results for our business.
input.summary: Add Section 2(e) confirming Client ownership of Client Content, Client IP and data, assignment of Support Services work product with vendor IP licence back, and no joint ownership.
